featured_reviews.name: kheela thakur
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with Relable Print Service was nothing short of a nightmare. I approached them to create professional business cards, but what I received looked shockingly cheap and unrefined—resembling flimsy garment tags rather than the polished product they promised.

The most frustrating part was their deceptive practices. They initially showed me high-quality samples to win my trust, but when I requested a sample of my design before finalizing the print, they outright refused. This lack of transparency should raise red flags for anyone considering their services. Unsurprisingly, the final product bore no resemblance to the samples they’d displayed—colors were off, the paper felt thin and scratchy, and the overall finish screamed amateur.

When I raised concerns, their customer service was dismissive and unapologetic. They offered no solution, refund, or even acknowledgment of their misleading tactics. It’s clear they prioritize taking orders over delivering on their promises.

Avoid Relable Print at all costs if you value quality, honesty, or professionalism. Save your time and money—this company cuts corners shamelessly and leaves customers stranded with subpar products. A 1-star rating feels generous for such a disheartening experience.

I later spoke to Dinesh, who confirmed that my order was in the cutting stage and would be delivered to the Dombivli pickup location on 6th February. However, when there was still no update, I called again only to be informed that the team had gone for a picnic and there was no one available in the office to provide any update on my urgent order.

This lack of accountability is unacceptable, especially for time-sensitive commitments. I request the owner, Abhishek, to take note of this and ensure that commitments are either honoured or not made in the first place.
